d:
The Pistons defeated the Magic, 104-86 tonight in Orlando. Isaiah Joe contributed a team-high 21 points to go with 5 three pointers and 4 rebounds, with Daniss Jenkins of the Pistons adding an additional 15 points (6-16 FG, 1-6 3P) in the game. Desmond Bane finished with a team-high 21 points along with 5 assists for the Magic in the losing effort. The Pistons improve their record to 11-6 with the win, while the Magic fall to 7-10 for the season.
